AccountNotificationPage.description: A bounded page from the current account's notification list.

AccountNotificationResponse.description: A content-free workflow notice; links grant no resource permissions.

AccountSummary.description: Account metadata for administration; contains no credential or link secrets.

ArticleContent.description: Revision-owned article fields; incomplete drafts may omit submission fields.

ArticleHistoryResponse.description: A permitted retained event and version snapshot.

ArticleImage.description: An image placement with contextual alternative text and an optional caption.

ArticleResponse.description: A private author-owned working article and its expected version.

ArticleSource.description: Attribution supplied by the article author.

ArticleSummaryResponse.description: A summary from the current author's workspace.

ChangeDisplayNameRequest.description: Updates the current account name at the expected version.

ChangePasswordRequest.description: Changes a password using the current password and account version.

ChangeRolesRequest.description: Desired staff roles and the last observed account version.

CorrectArticleRequest.description: Publish an editorial correction and retain any superseded author proposal.

CreateTemplateRequest.description: Proposes an owned Ready image for the shared library.

DeleteSuggestionRequest.description: The version to delete and the reason to retain in the audit record.

EmailDeliverySummary.description: Delivery metadata and sanitized failures; excludes recipient and protected mail content.

ForgotPasswordRequest.description: Requests a recovery Email without disclosing account existence.

ImageResponse.description: Authorized image status without storage credentials or object keys.

MediaVersionRequest.description: Expected version for an existing Media resource.

NotificationPreferenceResponse.description: Independent channel switches for one workflow event type.

PublicArticleResponse.description: Only the current publication, with no private revision identifiers or workflow state.

PublicArticleSummaryResponse.description: A public card summary; never exposes working revision content, body, or storage keys.

PublicCategoryBlock.description: A selected category and up to five current publications.

PublicTaxonomyResponse.description: A taxonomy name without private counts or staff metadata.

ReplayEmailRequest.description: Expected version of a still-valid failed Email delivery.

ResetPasswordRequest.description: Consumes a one-time recovery link and sets a new password.

ReviewArticleRequest.description: A versioned editorial action with optional workflow feedback.

ReviewResponse.description: A submitted snapshot and current assignment without unsent author content.

ReviewSummaryResponse.description: A bounded queue item; content and history require assignment.

SaveArticleRequest.description: Save an incomplete draft only if its expected record version is current.

SaveTaxonomyRequest.description: A name and archival update; existing entries require the expected version.

StaffSuggestionPage.description: A page of suggestions visible in the selected staff view.

StaffSuggestionResponse.description: A suggestion visible to an author or moderator under the current assignment rules.

SuggestionInput.description: A resident's text, event details, and optional contact information.

SuggestionPage.description: A page of the resident's current suggestions.

SuggestionResponse.description: A private view of a resident's suggestion.

SuggestionVersionRequest.description: The last version retrieved by the author.

SystemInfoResponse.description: Public application metadata for the frontend connection check.

TaxonomyResponse.description: A category or tag, including its archival and optimistic-concurrency state.

TemplateActionRequest.description: Versioned template decision or author resubmission.

TemplateResponse.description: An image proposal or authorized shared-library entry.

UpdateSuggestionRequest.description: Replacement details and the version last read by the resident.
